title: Display read-only owner-authorized completed Search Job provenance and explicit gaps
goal: Expose a bounded read-only run provenance projection (RunID, QueryVersion, UTC period, source/failure counts, audit count, missing evidence) from the same completed owner-authorized Search Job powering CAP-INV-007 transient workspace, with no new Trace persistence or source reads.
invariants: CAP-INV-008 semantics belong to Investigate; Search Job/Telemetry and canonical Trace remain Shared-owned; do not create a parallel provenance engine.
Only the exact already completed first-party owner-authorized SearchJob may feed the browser; no additional private source dereference or credential persistence.
Missing origin author, automation/tool calls, transformations, Case links and version fields must display as unavailable, not be invented.
OPEN-015 forbids claiming persistent Trace, and OPEN-013 remains untouched.
security_properties: Display only bounded safe run metadata and source/failure counts, not raw source labels, previews, token, tenant identifiers or event IDs.
A new Case/bearer/query/filter invalidates the displayed provenance; rejected or malformed SearchJob never leaves a partial provenance panel.
All actual Case/source permission reauthorization remains server-owned, unchanged.

migration.rationale: Ephemeral browser-only provenance projection, no new database or audit event.

rollback.strategy: Remove read-only provenance panel while keeping Class-0 workspace and source navigation unchanged.
verification: Existing CAP-INV-007 browser tests and first-party Go runtime unchanged.

inputs: Full CAP-INV-008 canonical fiche and Shared SearchJob type.
Completed authorized Event Search Job receipt in existing CAP-INV-007 local workspace.
Existing independent Case source navigation browser return test harness must include the same DOM elements as the analyst UI.
outputs: Transient provenance panel from completed authorized run with explicit unknown fields.
Fail-closed browser tests for scope changes, partial run metadata and invalid SearchJob.
Bounded GitHub handoff with exact CI and dependencies.
Existing Case return-navigation browser tests remain executable with provenance view present.
acceptance_tests: A completed owner-authorized SearchJob shows RunID, QueryVersion, UTC interval, only counts of sources/failures and audit events, without additional HTTP/source requests.
A missing provenance field remains explicitly unavailable; never fabricate actor, automation, transformation, links or full trace.
Changing bearer, Case or search criteria clears provenance; invalid or foreign SearchJob never publishes partial provenance.
Exact-head Linux Node+Go, macOS/Windows Go and mandatory engineering-kernel unchanged 90% floor are independently checked.

performance_budget.rationale: At most 200 first-party search results; projection is constant time plus bounded Sources/FailedSources array length checks.

definition_of_ready: CAP-INV-008 Class-0 read-only view permitted and first-party Search Job owner available.
OPEN-015 prevents only storage/retention, which is formally excluded.
Reuse existing ephemeral result browser; no new service.
definition_of_done: Browser tests prove authorized completed run, partial provenance, no source metadata leakage and stale invalidation.
Exact published HEAD CI and independent L2 status recorded without falsely elevating full CAP.
Prior Go security coverage remains mandatory, no waiver.
